```plato

//==
// # Gamma and beta family distributions
//
// The continuous families whose densities are expressed with the gamma or
// beta function: the gamma distribution itself, the beta distribution on
// [0, 1], and the chi-squared and Student's t sampling distributions derived
// from the normal. Each type is a pure parameter record; its
// Mean/Variance/Pdf/Cdf bodies live in `random.library.plato`,
// which also states the parameterization and the preconditions of each family.

// The gamma distribution in shape/scale form; its mean is Shape * Scale.
type GammaDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    Shape: Number;
    Scale: Number;
}
```
